title: Switch to TikTok Before Making
tests: Tests whether a mid-plan platform change overrides the original aspect ratio while retaining the creative brief.

faults.what: The scene looks predominantly photorealistic or realistically rendered rather than having the requested illustrated style.

judge.summary: The vertical clip shows a cosy rainy-window coffee scene with curling steam, but its realistic rendering misses the requested illustrated look.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is vertical 9:16, not widescreen.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames have a vertical 9:16 composition.

must_haves.item: A coffee cup sits on a windowsill with visible rain outside.
must_haves.why: A cup of dark coffee sits on a wooden windowsill in front of rain-covered glass.

must_haves.item: Steam visibly curls upward from the cup.
must_haves.why: A prominent curling steam plume rises from the coffee and changes shape across the sampled frames.

must_haves.item: The scene has a cosy illustrated appearance.
must_haves.why: Warm wood and soft lighting create a cosy mood, but the glossy ceramics, reflections, and realistic shading do not read as an illustrated treatment.

must_haves.item: The video lasts approximately 6 seconds and contains no text or audio.
must_haves.why: The stated 6.6-second duration is approximately six seconds, and no text is visible in the supplied frames; the presence or absence of audio cannot be determined from images.
